string.name: channel_passes_name
string.translation_description: Name of the notification channel for alerts shortly before a satellite passes overhead.

string.translation_description: Description of the satellite-pass notification channel.

string.translation_description: Title of the notification sent shortly before a satellite passes overhead. %1$s is the satellite name.

string.translation_description: Name of the notification channel for the alert sent the moment a satellite rises.

string.translation_description: Description of the notification channel for the alert sent the moment a satellite pass begins.

resources.string: Una alerta con vibración al comenzar el mejor paso visible de la noche

string.translation_description: Title of the notification sent the moment a satellite pass begins. %1$s is the satellite name.

string.name: notif_pass_now_text
string.translation_description: Body of the notification sent the moment a satellite pass begins.

resources.string: Mira hacia arriba: está cruzando el cielo ahora mismo

string.name: channel_eclipses_name
string.translation_description: Name of the notification channel for alerts before a lunar eclipse starts.

string.translation_description: Description of the lunar-eclipse notification channel.

string.translation_description: Title of the notification sent before a lunar eclipse starts. %1$s is a localized eclipse type like \'Total lunar eclipse\'.

string.name: notif_eclipse_text
string.translation_description: Body of the lunar eclipse notification, telling the user when it begins. %1$s is a time.

resources.string: Comienza alrededor de las %1$s — vale la pena salir a verlo

string.translation_description: Compact suffix appended after a widget rise/set time that falls on a later day than today, so a reader doesn\'t mistake it for today\'s crossing; %1$d is the number of days ahead (almost always 1). Keep it short — the widget is very narrow. Note the leading space.

string.translation_description: Button that adds the moon-phase widget to the home screen via the system dialog

string.translation_description: Title of the fallback dialog when the launcher cannot add widgets directly

string.translation_description: Body of the fallback dialog explaining how to add the widget manually
